title: Ines and the Witness
author: Oscar Lockridge
blurb: Mara Underhill, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
